title: test-request.json
description: Network Design asks Test to validate a scope. Fields under request mirror test.yml workflow inputs exactly so Test can trigger without translating.

status.description: PENDING when written. Test does not rewrite this file.

devices.description: Comma-separated hostnames. Empty means all SSH-capable devices in live_lab.

tags.description: Role tag selector, e.g. edge or wan. Empty when devices is set.

suites.description: Comma-separated live suites. Empty means reachability,routing,path.

reason.description: Why this run exists. Appears in the Test agent's reply.

expected_checks.description: Optional. Check ids Design expects to run, so Test can flag silent N/A.

context.description: Optional. What was deployed, for the risk brief.
